title: Navan earns 15 No. 1 rankings in G2’s fall 2026 reports
summary: Navan continues to earn customer endorsement in G2’s fall 2026 reports, with top rankings across travel, spend, usability, and results.
body_markdown:
G2 has released its Fall 2026 reports, and Navan continues to earn recognition across travel management, spend management, mileage tracking, and regional categories.


This season, Navan earned 93 G2 badges, including 15 No. 1 rankings across travel management, spend management, mileage tracking, and regional categories. Together, these results demonstrate Navan’s strength across customer satisfaction, usability, implementation, business outcomes, and global market performance.


## Customers continue to rate Navan highly for travel and expense


Navan earned the highest satisfaction score among all products in G2’s Travel & Expense Grid, with a 96/100 satisfaction score based on more than 9,000 reviews. Navan is also the most reviewed product in the category, with more than 2,000 more reviews than any other product.


In G2’s Travel & Expense Grid, Navan ranked No. 2 overall among leaders. But the overall Grid placement only tells part of the story.


Navan earned a 96/100 satisfaction score, based on more than 9,000 reviews. While G2’s overall ranking also considers market presence, Navan’s customer satisfaction results show that users continue to give the platform exceptionally high ratings.


Earlier this year, Navan ranked No. 1 overall in[G2's Spring 2026 Travel & Expense Grid](https://navan.com/resources/reports/g2-grid-report-travel-and-expense-management-leader-spring-2026) . The fall results build on that recognition by highlighting the breadth of Navan’s leadership across additional categories, customer segments, and regions.


Navan also ranked No. 1 in the Mid-Market Grid for Travel & Expense and No. 2 in the Enterprise Grid, reinforcing its ability to support organizations across a range of business sizes.


These results reflect the experience Navan customers have every day — an intuitive solution for booking business travel, managing expenses, simplifying admin work, and gaining visibility into spend.


## No. 1 in Travel Management


Navan earned the No. 1 position in G2’s overall Travel Management Grid, as well as the No. 1 position in the Mid-Market Travel Management Grid.


Navan also ranked No. 1 in the Momentum Grid for Travel Management, signaling continued strength in a category where businesses are looking for a more modern alternative to legacy travel management tools.


## Enterprise spend management leadership


Navan’s fall 2026 results also demonstrate strong performance in spend management, particularly among enterprise organizations.


Navan ranked No. 1 in the following categories:


- Enterprise Spend Management Grid
- Enterprise EMEA Regional Grid for Spend Management
- Enterprise Americas Regional Grid for Spend Management
- Enterprise Relationship Index for Spend Management
- Enterprise Implementation Index for Spend Management


Together, these No. 1 placements highlight Navan’s recognition across enterprise spend management, including regional, relationship, and implementation categories.


With support for complex programs, global teams, and multiple spend workflows, Navan helps organizations create greater control and visibility without adding unnecessary friction for employees or admins.


## Recognized for usability and results in mileage tracking


Navan also earned several No. 1 rankings in mileage tracking, including:


- Momentum Grid for Mileage Tracking
- Usability Index for Mileage Tracking
- Results Index for Mileage Tracking
- Europe Regional Grid for Mileage Tracking
- EMEA Regional Grid for Mileage Tracking


Together, these No. 1 rankings show that Navan earned recognition across momentum, usability, results, and regional categories in mileage tracking.


## A strong season across categories and regions


Across travel management, spend management, mileage tracking, and regional categories, Navan continues to earn recognition in G2’s Fall 2026 reports.


The G2 Fall 2026 results show that Navan’s recognition extends across multiple categories and indices, including travel management, spend management, mileage tracking, regional performance, implementation, relationships, momentum, usability, and results.


As businesses look for a more connected way to manage travel, payments, and expenses, Navan remains focused on helping teams move faster, stay compliant, and spend smarter.
